_note: Initial catalog from the brief; corrected from RESEARCH.md / models.catalog.json when the research lane lands. size_bytes are the repo's safetensors totals (approx). ctx_usable_8gb is a RAM budget on an 8 GB iPhone 16 Pro, not a model limit — unproven until measured on device.

models.name: Qwen3 0.6B (4-bit)
models.notes: Smallest useful tool-caller; thinking on by default.

models.name: Qwen3 1.7B (4-bit)
models.notes: Default pick: Hermes-style <tool_call> tags, good at JSON.

models.name: Qwen3 4B (4-bit)
models.notes: Best quality that still fits an 8 GB phone; slow TTFT.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct (4-bit)
models.notes: Meta licence — accept on HF and paste a token.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct (4-bit)
models.notes: Meta licence — accept on HF and paste a token.

models.name: Gemma 3 1B IT (4-bit)
models.notes: Google licence — gated. No native tool role; loopl folds tool results into user turns.

models.name: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct (4-bit)
models.notes: Apache-2.0, no tool template — manual JSON prompting.

models.name: Phi-4 mini Instruct (4-bit)
models.notes: MIT. Tool template uses <|tool|> blocks; parser falls back to JSON.

models.name: Apple Intelligence (on-device)
models.notes: iOS 26+, Apple Intelligence enabled. Zero download. Native Tool protocol; 4096-token window (GenerationError.exceededContextWindowSize).
